findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes and over the complete observed window are strongest for pair-distance shell densities at short separations: pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 show positive whole-window integrated z with positive batch fractions of 1.0 (endpoint_effects:9, endpoint_effects:10), while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (endpoint_effects:13). These are selection-enrichment contrasts on a standardized coordinate feature, not an absolute geometric descriptor or a physical interaction energy.

Landmark soft-minimum and occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions: landmark_00_softmin is negative (endpoint_effects:14) while landmark_00_occupancy3 is positive (endpoint_effects:15); landmark_06_softmin is positive (endpoint_effects:32) while landmark_06_occupancy5 is negative (endpoint_effects:34). Because softmin is a normalized soft minimum distance and occupancy is a radial shell density, the two observables are not on a shared quality axis and their signs cannot be compared directly.

Available descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head survival enrichment, not decoded terminal affinity: survival_effects:0 (landmark_00_soft_mass), survival_effects:70 (landmark_07_soft_mass), survival_effects:100 (landmark_10_soft_mass), survival_effects:186 (landmark_18_local_czz), survival_effects:249 and survival_effects:393 are survival_enrichment_z or survival_enrichment_change_rate_z measures. The manifest states decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts disagree in direction with some population contrasts: increment_effects:14 (landmark_00_softmin) and increment_effects:3/4 (shape_xx, shape_yy) are negative, while increment_effects:15 (landmark_00_occupancy3) and increment_effects:10 (pair_kernel_2.5) are positive. Turnover residual rates for landmark_00_local_cxx (turnover:14), landmark_00_local_cyy (turnover:17), landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:47), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:134), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:224) and landmark_07_local_cyy (turnover:227) are large and positive, indicating that within-path change and changing cohort composition are not separable from these tables alone.

Joint-motion diagnostics are the most consistently signed branch-adjusted effects: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are negative under raw covariance (branch_adjusted:74, branch_adjusted:76), adjusted covariance (branch_adjusted:151, branch_adjusted:153), raw correlation (branch_adjusted:228, branch_adjusted:230) and adjusted correlation (branch_adjusted:305, branch_adjusted:307), with same-sign batch fractions near 0.93-1.0. This indicates that regions with larger joint innovation or internal RMS are less enriched, i.e. common motion carries information beyond isolated marginal descriptors.

Short-range pair kernels retain positive adjusted-covariance and adjusted-correlation effects after branch adjustment (branch_adjusted:86, branch_adjusted:87, branch_adjusted:240, branch_adjusted:241), whereas pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (branch_adjusted:167, branch_adjusted:244). The adjustment is a supplied branch covariance/correlation adjustment; the region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals, so this is coupling evidence rather than a causal mechanism.

The supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over the complete observed support [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed false, and they show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts (e.g. continuous:0 landmark_00_soft_mass has 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; continuous:1 landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; continuous:70-73 landmark_07 features have 4-6 sign changes). A constant rule is therefore not supported by these curves, but the curves are contrasts, not absolute reward targets.

First-rate and last-rate z values for the soft_mass features across landmarks 00-19 are large in magnitude and frequently opposite in sign (e.g. continuous:0 first_rate_z 9.27 versus last_rate_z -10.00; continuous:10 first_rate_z -25.98 versus last_rate_z 0.89; continuous:100 first_rate_z 66.28 versus last_rate_z -11.56). This supports a time-conditioned rather than constant contrast rule within the observed window, without arbitrary time bins or extrapolation.

The curve fidelity audit reports relative_node_rmse values of roughly 0.30-0.99 and quiet_node_large_fit_fraction up to 0.34, with legendre_runtime_allowed false for every audited feature. The selected_count is 24 under a rule requiring relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0 and quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1, so only a minority of features pass the fidelity screen and polynomial fits are not accepted.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A of 0.081 (CI95 0.070-0.092) and compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation of 0.102 (CI95 0.065-0.140), with the explicit limitation that these are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that nonnegative excess distance is by construction. Joint diagnostics show selection_innovation/innovation_native_alignment and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment are positive and null-tested (joint_diagnostics:1, joint_diagnostics:11), while observed_child_score_gain is negative (joint_diagnostics:2), and teacher_contrast_internal_fraction is 0.787 (joint_diagnostics:14).

Regional enrichment_z and enrichment_change_rate_z and parent_edge_contrast_rate_z are separate measures with different signs for the same region: for landmark_00_soft_mass, enrichment_z is 0.639 (regional_effects:0) while parent_edge_contrast_rate_z is 4.545 (regional_effects:400); for landmark_02_local_dy, enrichment_z is 0.405 (regional_effects:22) while parent_edge_contrast_rate_z is 2.317 (regional_effects:420). These are accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects or atom velocities.

Global centroid coordinates show weak and inconsistent branch-adjusted effects: raw covariance global_centroid_x/y/z have p values 0.595, 0.546 and 0.950 (branch_adjusted:0-2), adjusted covariance p values 0.946, 0.777 and 0.849 (branch_adjusted:77-79), and raw correlation p values 0.793, 0.248 and 0.103 (branch_adjusted:154-156). These null and weak effects are retained rather than dropped.

hypotheses.claim: A testable coordinate intervention would target short-range pair-distance shell density (pair_kernel_1.5-2.5) at evidence-bound landmarks with the largest positive enrichment, using the registered pointcloud_delta_A edit at 0.5-2.0 A and teacher_neighbors 2-4-8. Observable: pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 contrast. Intended response: increased favorable-minus-comparison contrast at observed selection nodes. Target origin: supplied landmark coordinates. Spatial scale: 1.5-2.5 A pair separations. Discriminating failure condition: no change in pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 contrast or a sign reversal in the branch-adjusted effect.

A time-conditioned contrast rule using the validated observed-node interpolation (temporal_teacher_blend 0.25-1.0) could express the sign changes seen in the soft_mass and local_dx curves, whereas a constant rule cannot. Observable: time-conditioned favorable-minus-comparison contrast. Intended response: improved contrast fidelity at actual score nodes. Target origin: supplied static teacher coordinates. Temporal scale: observed support [0.0,0.49]. Discriminating failure condition: no improvement over the constant rule or extrapolation beyond the observed support.

A joint-motion-aware regional attention recipe could be tested by comparing coherent joint coordinate patterns against isolated marginal descriptors, using the supplied adjusted covariance and correlation diagnostics. Observable: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A contrasts. Intended response: reduced enrichment in high-joint-motion regions. Target origin: supplied joint diagnostics. Spatial scale: region radius 5.0 A. Discriminating failure condition: no separation between joint and marginal descriptors or a sign reversal after adjustment.

The disagreement between population-contrast changes and parent-child increment contrasts, together with large turnover residual rates, could be explained by changing cohort composition rather than within-path change. Observable: turnover_residual_rate versus edge_rate and population_rate. Intended response: attribution of contrast change to reclassification and parent weighting. Target origin: supplied turnover accounting. Temporal scale: complete observed window. Discriminating failure condition: turnover residual not distinguishable from zero or no reclassification evidence.

Immediate selection evidence and descendant survival credit could be compared directly, but without decoded terminal labels the comparison remains unavailable. Observable: selection enrichment versus survival enrichment. Intended response: identification of survivor bias. Target origin: supplied lineage support. Temporal scale: complete observed window. Discriminating failure condition: survival credit not separable from selection enrichment or terminal labels unavailable.

The curve fidelity audit could be used to restrict any time-conditioned rule to features passing the relative_rmse_le 0.35 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0 screen, since only 24 of the audited features pass. Observable: relative_node_rmse and strong_sign_conflict_nodes. Intended response: exclusion of low-fidelity curves. Target origin: supplied curve support. Temporal scale: observed support only. Discriminating failure condition: no feature passes the screen or the screen does not predict contrast fidelity.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; moment effects, pair kernels and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed.
